shortDescription: List and filter on Object Storage Quotas.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Object Storage Quotas to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Object Storage Quotas.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Object Storage Quotas in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Object Storage Quotas by.
